note: Mechanical data of popular dev boards for enclosure design. Each object has src (key of the board's sources map) and verify (fields NOT read from that document). Board frame: see frame.
frame: mm. Origin at the bottom-left corner of the PCB seen from the component (top) side, as drawn in the official drawing; x right, y up (away), z up from the PCB bottom face. Component z values are heights above the face they sit on.

typical._note: Typical envelopes in mm when the board drawing gives no height. h = height above the PCB face. plug = cross-section of the mating cable plug overmold [w, h]; insert = how far the plug body must reach past the receptacle mouth. All verify:true.
